en.why_it_matters: The familiar Yamamoto small-room thread takes a different turn here: Hiroshi Kagawa is unavailable, so veteran bassist Mitsuaki Furuno joins Yamamoto and Toshio Osumi. That changes the rhythm-section chemistry without turning the night into a novelty booking, and it gives this recurring Yokohama stop a concrete reason to hear this specific date.
en.trip_verdict: If October 16 lands inside a Greater Tokyo/Kanto stay, build the evening around YOKOHAMA JAZZ FIRST. The lineup change makes this more interesting than a routine repeat, but it is not a standalone reason to cross the Pacific.
